newsitem.title: POLAND: OPTIMUS WANTS NEW SHARE LISTING MARCH 26.
newsitem.headline: OPTIMUS WANTS NEW SHARE LISTING MARCH 26.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA wants to postpone to March 26 bourse trade in its 1.104,573 new shares, issued for conversion for 159 convertible bonds, from earlier requested March 19, Optimus said in a statement.
Optimus received the orders to convert the 159 of its 300 five-year convertible bonds into shares last month.
Last week Optimus said it had received orders to convert into shares another 20 of the bonds and as a result its share capital would increase by 138,940 shares.
The conversion of all the bonds would bring the firm's number of shares outstanding to 6,484,108.
